body: Agree ako sa transferability test, Kiko, pero dagdagan ko ng mas masakit na metric: total integration hours. Puwedeng technically 'transferable' ang model pero kung kailangan pa rin ng months of mapping, safety tuning at exception handling bawat site, hindi pa iyon scalable advantage. I want before/after numbers for setup engineering, intervention rate, scrap and uptime—not a vocabulary contest about 'foundation models.' Kapag bumaba talaga ang integration burden across sites, saka ako bibili ng physical-AI story nang walang discount coupon.
